title: Harmony Heights Duo w/ Hot Tub & Skyline Views
description:
Experience Nashville in style with this combo of two modern 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom homes side by side to each other! Enjoy rooftop living with a private hot tub (Unit 15), cozy seating areas, and fully equipped kitchens. Ideal for large groups, families, or friends looking to stay together near Downtown Nashville.

Each unit has 7 beds(1 king,6 queens) and  a 2 car garage with additional free parking onsite!

The space
This Harmony Heights duo includes Units 14 and 15, two spacious 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom homes designed for comfort, style, and convenient group travel near downtown. Together, these homes offer 10 bedrooms, 14 beds, and 10 bathrooms, comfortably accommodating groups of up to 28 guests.

Unit 14 – Rooftop Living Near Downtown

5 Bedrooms | 7 Beds | 5 Bathrooms
Enjoy a modern open layout, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private rooftop deck perfect for relaxing, dining, or entertaining.

Unit 15 – Modern Rooftop Getaway w/ Hot Tub

5 Bedrooms | 7 Beds | 5 Bathrooms
Features a private rooftop lounge complete with a hot tub—ideal for unwinding at the end of the day.

Combined Features

-10 Bedrooms / 14 Beds / 11 Bathrooms

-1 King + 6 Queens in each unit (14 beds total)

-Fully stocked kitchens in both homes

-Open-concept living and dining spaces designed for groups

-Private rooftop decks; Unit 15 includes a hot tub

-Washer & dryer in each unit for added convenience

These two homes offer plenty of room to gather while still giving your group the flexibility and privacy of separate spaces—all within the same modern community.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
